name: Orc Triath

attributes.attribute: Irish parallel to the Welsh Twrch Trwyth
a magical boar owned by Brigit

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: In Irish myth Orc Triath is a magical beast. The name marks the Irish form of the Welsh Twrch Trwyth. The goddess Brigit kept this creature as a boar.

okr.objective: Orc Triath is the magical boar of the goddess Brigit.
key_results: Orc Triath is a beast in Irish myth.
It stands as the Irish form of the Welsh Twrch Trwyth.
The goddess Brigit owned this magical boar.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
